reviews.body:
Thanks, good catch. `claude-3-5-sonnet-latest` (Sonnet 3.5 retired 2025-10-28) and `gemini-1.5-pro` (retired on Vertex by 2025-09-24) have been dead defaults for a while, so `new AnthropicChatModel()` and `new GoogleVertexChatModel()` fail without an explicit model.

`claude-haiku-4-5` keeps TypeScript consistent with the Python side in #1857, and the Vercel adapter's hardcoded `temperature: 0` rules out the newest Claude models for now. It does move the TS default from the Sonnet tier to Haiku. That's fine for a default; anyone who wants more capability can set `ANTHROPIC_CHAT_MODEL`. As in #1857, Gemini 3.x on Vertex needs `location: "global"` (or `us`/`eu`), not a regional endpoint.

vitest, tsc, eslint and prettier pass locally. I'll merge once CI is green.
